subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that best expresses the meaning of the proverb in the given sentence.

The salesperson for the project offered a sneak peek of the project as we expressed our interest in the area and amenities.

options.text: To be in a winning position

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Getting a preview of something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"sneak peek"** means getting a brief and informal preview of something. (झलक)

 
 
• **Example: **The author gave a sneak peek of her upcoming novel to a select group of fans.
 
 
 
• **"Getting a preview of something"** refers to seeing or experiencing a part of something before it is fully available. (पूर्वावलोकन)
 
 
• **Example: **We got a preview of the new movie before its official release.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Getting a preview of something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To try something new** (कुछ नया आजमाना): It means to experience or attempt something that one has not done before.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to try something new and joined a cooking class.
 
 
 
• **Sending a brief letter** (संक्षिप्त पत्र भेजना): It refers to the act of sending a short written message.
 
 
• **Example: **He sent a brief letter to his parents explaining his absence.
 
 
 
• **To be in a winning position** (जीत की स्थिति में होना): It means to be in a favorable position to win or succeed.
 
 
• **Example:** The team was in a winning position after scoring the last goal.
